verdict.rationale: Otter's own marketing claims live transcription in multiple languages, so the core capability exists, but this is a single thin mention with no detail on which languages, how many, or how well they work. Nothing in the evidence addresses non-English summaries or switching languages mid-meeting. Missing for 10: a documented list or count of supported languages, multilingual summary generation, mid-meeting language-switching or code-switching handling, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of non-English accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run meetings in languages other than English — transcription and summaries support many languages and handle language switching

citations.quote: Live transcription in multiple languages, and speaker recognition.
